bio.text: Micah Jones is the Republican nominee for Massachusetts's 6th Congressional District in 2026; he was unopposed in the September 1 Republican primary.
He served in the military in the 82nd Airborne Division, with a deployment to Afghanistan from 2014 to 2015, and later became an attorney after law school.

sources.title: Republican veteran eyes rare open seat to flip blue state district
Dan Koh wins primary for 6th congressional district to replace Seth Moulton
